question: define 'pathological goban' formally, then measure it at every solved size

component_definitions.1_full_kill: positions where one colour has zero stones on the goban; per non-settled slot, whether a full-kill move exists and whether one is optimal (child stored value == stored value)
component_definitions.2_ko_density: KO_SENSITIVE (L<H) slot fraction (WZO1 flag; WZO2 L<H separately) and the independent-ko-count distribution (B23 static shapes)
component_definitions.3_pass_optimality: per non-settled slot, whether the pass edge (V1(P,-side)) equals the stored V0 value
component_definitions.4_cycle_reachability: Tarjan SCCs over the full (pos, side, ko, passes in {0,1}) move graph; whether a non-trivial SCC is root-reachable; cycle-reachable fraction (I5's notion)
component_definitions.5_history_dependence: fraction of L==H slots whose exact value differs under some reachable history; measured at 2x2 (0) and 3x2 (30.3%), structurally bounded elsewhere by cycle-reachability and pending-ko potential

ko_sens_fraction_wzo2.note: 4x3 has no WZO2 artifact. The brief's 170,181/643,378 = 26.45% mixes the I5-graph numerator (flagged ko=none passes=0 states in the reachable graph, 170,181, missing 95 unreachable flagged slots) with the WZO1 all-slot denominator; WZO1 measured here: 170,276/643,378 = 26.47% (all slots), 170,276/640,110 = 26.60% (non-settled).

4b_cycle_reachability_i5_committed.note: I5 graph models differ from the t382 cycles model at 4x3 (pos,side,passes, no ko dimension; V=3x side-slots) — cited, not re-measured.

2x2.denominator: all L==H slots x histories (T12 C2-pilot); EXP-8 sample: 0/10 L==H diverged

3x3.measured: not measured (cost: T13 exhaustive at 3x2 ~5min/17 workers; 3x3 line space >=10^4x larger; EXP-8 shows exact-PSK-under-history budget-intractable even at 3x2)
3x3.structural_bound_cycle: 100.0% of L==H ko=none p0 slots cycle-reachable (measured)

4x3.structural_bound_cycle: unmeasured here; I5 shows all ko-sensitive cycle-reachable at 4x3

4x4.structural_bound_cycle: 98.5% of states cycle-reachable (I5); all KO_SENSITIVE cycle-reachable

answer.smallest_board_with_realistic_ko: 3x2 — history dependence measured 0 at 2x2 and 30.3% at 3x2 (T13); the operator's 3x3 guess was one rung high
answer.threshold_verdict: no defensible clean threshold: pathology is a gradient, with two real jumps — (a) 2x2 -> 3x2 (history dependence 0 -> 30.3%, pass-optimality among L==H 0% -> 23%, full-kill positions 51% -> 26%), (b) first 2-ko positions at 4x3 (0.55% of ko-sensitive slots), first 3-ko at 4x4 (0.0025%). 2x2 is pathological in the opposite direction (ko shapes exist but never change an L==H value; 51% of positions are annihilations).
answer.ko_mechanism_note: the 3x2 history dependence is driven by full-goban position-repetition bans (PSK), not ko recaptures per se (T13's hand-verified example idx=413: a goban-winning capture repeats a position from 5 plies earlier); 2x2's divergence (EXP-8, KO_SENS region only) is ko-recapture-driven. Both mechanisms are absent from L==H values at 2x2.
answer.sevenfold_claim_corrected: the brief's '7x drop' (26.45% -> 3.49%) mixes WZO1 (4x3) with WZO2 (4x4) denominators; on consistent WZO1 the KO_SENS fraction falls gently 26.5% -> 21.3% (1.2x); on consistent WZO2 (3x3 -> 4x4) it falls 10.9% -> 3.5% (3.1x). The trend direction is real, the magnitude is format-dependent.
